versions.changelog: Added comprehensive strategy guide for agents, FAQ section with common pitfalls, example FEN strings for testing, minimal agent game loop pseudocode, and clearer documentation on move validation and chess engine integration
Updated documentation and agent integration guide

lawbchess 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Enables on-chain wagered chess at lawb.xyz/chess for EVM wallet users.
- Supports game creation, joining, move protocol, winner payout, and refunds via smart contracts.
- Integrates with Firebase for real-time board state, move syncing, and game records.
- Includes support for multiple EVM chains (Base, Sanko, Arbitrum) and various tokens.
- Allows challenging Clawb, spectating via retake.tv/clawb, and participating in tournaments and bounties.
